sourceCardNo.description: The source's own card number, which is the id's number on every record.

name.description: The move's title, verbatim from its card heading. Measured range 15-62 characters.

stage.description: The stage heading the card is numbered under, verbatim.
enum: De-escalation, Resistance Defusal & Countering Bad Faith

kicker.description: The short stage name the card's front prints, in stage order.

scenario.description: The source's Negotiation Scenario, verbatim. Measured range 58-231 characters.

scenarioSize.description: The front's scenario point size, derived from its measured length at the layout map's bands. Every front is measured at its assigned size before the deck ships.

nameSize.description: The front's name point size, derived from its measured length: 12 pt at fifty characters or fewer, 11.5 to fifty-eight, 11 above. The five long names step down rather than wrap.

schematic.description: The line the card prints under the figure, in the form '<Family> at <unit> <mark> of <divisions>'. The same three numbers are in figure.parametricParams, and the deck's test regenerates this line from them.

script.description: The source's Concrete Dialogue Script, verbatim after the declared rendering table, one entry per printed line. A script written as a list prints one line per item. Measured 1-4 lines and 60-344 characters per line.

defense.description: The counter-move, this deck's compression of the source's Counter-Move Defense. Measured 102-120 characters. Compression may drop explanation but not a claim, a number or a stated bound.

defenseSize.description: The back face's point size, fixed per card in the layout map from the measured fit. Three cards are declared at 6.5 pt; every other card prints at 7.

origin.description: Two tiers and no third. The line is the attribution the source's own text gives - a named researcher with the year the source gives, or a surname the title carries with no year because the source gives none. Where the source names nobody, the note is the honest line.

originFull.description: The source's Behavioral Science Origin, verbatim after the declared rendering table, printed in the rules file and the stage resource. Measured range 138-375 characters.

defenseFull.description: The source's Counter-Move Defense, verbatim after the declared rendering table. Measured range 179-360 characters.
